mutant.lineText: const defs = o.shape === 'circle' ? `<defs><clipPath id="${id}"><circle cx="35" cy="35" r="35"/></clipPath></defs>` : '';
mutant.nextText: return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 70 70" width="${size}" height="${size}" role="img" aria-label="${escapeXml(o.label ?? 'Avatar')}">${defs}<g${clip}><rect width="70" height="70" fill="${bg}"/><g fill="${fg}">${rects.join('')}</g></g></svg>`;
